title: Haste and Waste; Or, the Young Pilot of Lake Champlain. A Story for Young People
sourceTitle: Haste and Waste; Or, the Young Pilot of Lake Champlain. A Story for Young People
author: Oliver Optic
description: "Haste and Waste; Or, the Young Pilot of Lake Champlain" by Oliver Optic is a novel for young readers written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The story revolves around Lawry Wilford, a fourteen-year-old boy who is a skilled pilot on Lake Champlain.

authorInfo.bio: William Taylor Adams, pseudonym Oliver Optic, was an academic, author, and a member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives.
